sentences.asr_text: Questions 1 to 5 are based on the first interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Hey, Kathy.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 嘿，凯西。

sentences.en: Did you read this article in the magazine?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你看过杂志上的这篇文章了吗？

sentences.en: I can’t believe how much man’s changing the planet.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信，人类对地球的改变竟然这么大。

sentences.en: Yeah, I had a look at it.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 嗯，我看过了。

sentences.en: Quite interesting I suppose if you believe that sort of thing.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我想，如果你相信这类事情的话，那倒挺有意思。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: What do you mean “if you believe that sort of thing?”
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你说“如果你相信这类事情”，是什么意思？

sentences.en: Are you saying you don’t believe that we are damaging the planet?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你是说，你不相信我们正在破坏地球吗？

sentences.en: To be honest, Mark, not really.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 说实话，马克，我不太相信。

sentences.en: What are you saying?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你在说什么？

sentences.en: Are you saying global warming isn’t a fact?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你是说，全球变暖不是事实？

sentences.en: Deforestation isn’t a fact?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 森林砍伐也不是事实？

sentences.en: The greenhouse effect isn’t actually happening?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 温室效应也并没有真的发生？

sentences.en: Hey, calm down Mark.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 嘿，马克，冷静一点。

sentences.en: I just think too many people take these things as being definitely true without knowing all the facts.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，有太多人还没了解全部事实，就认定这些事绝对是真的。

sentences.en: You really don’t think global warming is happening.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你真的认为全球变暖并没有发生？

sentences.en: You know they’ve said sea levels are going to rise by quite a few meters over the next 50 to 100 years.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们说未来50到100年，海平面将会上升好几米。

sentences.en: Weather conditions are getting worse all over the world.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 世界各地的天气状况都在恶化。

sentences.en: Can you remember how many big hurricanes there have been in this country over the last few years?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你还记得过去几年，我们国家遭遇了多少次强飓风吗？

sentences.en: I think evidence is all around us.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 我觉得证据就在我们身边。

sentences.en: I don’t think we have enough information, to be honest.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 说实话，我认为我们的信息还不够充分。

sentences.en: We’ve only been measuring these things for around two or three hundred years.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我们对这些现象进行测量，不过也就两三百年。

sentences.en: We have no idea what was happening 50,000 years ago.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 五万年前发生过什么，我们根本不知道。

sentences.en: For all we know, this is just a natural blip, a kind of sudden but temporary change, in the whole climate cycle.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 说不定，这只是整个气候周期中一次自然的小波动，也就是一种突然而短暂的变化。

w.m: phr.说不定；或许（表示没有足够信息作判断）

sentences.en: I don’t think we should change how we’re living just because of 20 years of abnormal measurements.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我不认为，我们仅仅因为二十年的异常测量数据，就应该改变自己的生活方式。

sentences.en: And don’t you think all the other effects we’re having on the planet are destructive?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 那么，你不认为我们对地球造成的其他种种影响也具有破坏性吗？

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 你指的是什么？

sentences.en: I mean like deforestation, overpopulation, threatening the existence of many endangered animals.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 比如森林砍伐、人口过剩，以及威胁许多濒危动物的生存。

sentences.en: Pollution of the air and the seas.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 还有对空气和海洋的污染。

sentences.en: I mean, I could go on if you want.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，我还可以继续列举。

sentences.en: No, no, I understand what you’re saying.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 不，不，我明白你的意思。

sentences.en: And, yes, it’s true that there are several problems worldwide caused by human influence.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 而且，没错，世界各地的确有一些问题是人类活动造成的。

sentences.en: I think the destruction of the Amazon rainforest is really dangerous and it’s something we could live to regret.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我认为，亚马孙雨林遭到破坏确实很危险，将来我们可能会为此后悔。

sentences.en: I read somewhere that they were considered to be the lungs of the planet.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我曾在哪里读到过，它被称为地球之肺。

w.m: n.肺；此处比喻重要的生态调节者

sentences.en: And there we are happily chopping it all down and it would be a shame to lose some of those animals that may become extinct.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 可我们却还高高兴兴地把它砍掉；还有，失去一些可能灭绝的动物也很可惜。

sentences.en: You know, like the rhino or the panda.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 比如犀牛或熊猫。

sentences.en: But I think we shouldn’t interfere with nature if they are going to become extinct.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 不过我认为，我们不该干涉自然；如果这些动物将要灭绝，

sentences.en: Then we have to allow nature to take its course.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 那我们就得让自然顺其发展。

sentences.en: You’ve just contradicted yourself in two sentences Kathy.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 凯西，你前后两句话就自相矛盾了。

sentences.en: First you said it’s bad that we’re interfering with nature by destroying the rainforest, and then......
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你先说，我们破坏雨林、干涉自然是件坏事，然后又……

sentences.en: That’s not the same thing.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 那不是一回事。

sentences.en: Well of course it is.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 怎么不是一回事，当然是！

sentences.en: The only reason 99% of these animals are endangered is precisely because WE are threatening their habitats either by chopping it down as you say, or by expanding towns and farming into areas where these animals normally live and hunt.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 这些动物中99%之所以濒危，恰恰就是因为我们在威胁它们的栖息地：要么像你说的那样砍掉森林，要么把城镇和农田扩展到它们原本生活、觅食的地方。

sentences.en: You can’t destroy an animal’s habitat and then turn around and say we can’t interfere with nature to save it.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你不能先破坏动物的栖息地，然后掉过头来说，不能为了拯救它们而干涉自然。

sentences.en: I don’t think having 20 panda cubs in zoos around the world is a very smart way to save an animal.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我不认为，在世界各地的动物园里养二十只熊猫幼崽，就是拯救一种动物的明智办法。

sentences.en: It’s totally artificial and is cruel to the animals involved.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 那完全是人为的，对涉及其中的动物也很残忍。

sentences.en: I would go along with that.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 这一点我赞同。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The real solution is to save the animals’ original habitat.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 真正的解决办法是保护这些动物原本的栖息地。

sentences.en: This is the end of the first interview.
sentences.zh: 第一段访谈到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of the first interview.

sentences.speaker: M

sentences.speaker: M

sentences.speaker: M
